verdict.rationale: A probe confirms llms.txt is live at https://docs.adyen.com/llms.txt with a proper description of Adyen's docs (including Issuing), and the docs site consistently supports .md variants of pages (many docs URLs end in .md), showing agent-oriented markdown access. Missing for 10: no dedicated llms.txt section specific to Issuing product, and openapi.json spec is not discoverable, so full machine-readable API description isn't confirmed.
